text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Wah! It's Lady Orfevre! The real deal! So 
cool!!

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Lady Orfevre, come play with me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Run, and make a racket. That is a 
child's duty.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Just don't get tangled in my legs. If 
I hit you, you'll get hurt."

Surrounded by innocent children, Orfevre 
seemed to have had her energy drained far 
more than she expected...
